skills.description: Turn one topic into a batch of genuinely different short videos with Jimeng, ready for matrix-account distribution. WorkBuddy does the batching, de-duplication and scheduling; the user only signs off at four checkpoints. Includes a parameter-level batch contract (variable slots, combination rules, de-dup thresholds, per-batch caps, credit budget), a five-step Jimeng CLI/API probe-and-map procedure with a fillable parameter mapping sheet, a J0-J6 staged workflow with explicit timeout contracts, a unified error-code table (J0xx-J5xx) with first-action fixes and unrecoverable criteria, one complete end-to-end 30-video example from task card to acceptance checklist, an independent FAQ, and hard rules on platform de-duplication, AI-content declaration and credit burn. Use when the user wants to produce many videos from one topic, run matrix accounts, batch-generate differentiated hooks/covers/titles, complains that batch outputs all look the same, or asks how to keep a character consistent across dozens of generated clips. 适用于：一条选题批量出片、矩阵号分发、钩子与封面批量差异化、批量结果撞脸去重、积分成本控制、批量生成卡住或中途失败。
